detail.longDescription:
What's a #kubernetes Job and why should we care about creating Jobs?

The idea behind a kubernetes job is, that, contrary to a simple pod, it will keep trying to create and run the templated pod until it succeeds.

If you remember the bash roulette game, here's a modified version that demonstrates the kuberoulette:

kubectl create job kuberoulette --image registry.access.redhat.com/ubi10/ubi -- /bin/bash -c "[ \$[ \$RANDOM % 6] = 0 ] && echo Success || (echo Nope && exit 1) "
